reference: Existing OpenGold source heads are edit targets. A locally decoded original HEAD portrait is supplied only as a modular neck join reference and is not distributed.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: Image 1, the existing OpenGold male portrait. Reference Image 2 is an original 88x40 game head, supplied ONLY to show the modular neck join, not to copy its face. Keep Image 1's character identity, expression, face, hair/horns/ears, approved colors and chunky pixel-art style. Correct the head and NECK GEOMETRY for a separate armor body attached immediately below the canvas. Output ONLY the edited head on opaque pure black, wide 88:40 canvas, preferably 1760x800. Think in a logical 88x40 pixel grid: head top including horns y=1..3, face and complete chin end no lower than y=32, leaving a clearly visible short neck below the jaw down to y=39. Neck sides below the jaw must descend naturally and nearly vertically, with no sideways flare, shoulder fragment or sloping cut-off. Neck ends with a clean FLAT HORIZONTAL base exactly at the bottom canvas edge, spanning logical x=36 through55 inclusive (center x=46). No black bottom padding inside that neck span. Keep distinct dark jaw contour ABOVE the neck base, never on it. Position the head anatomically over this neck; do not simply slide a neck strip under an offset head. Slightly reduce the head to give the chin clearance if needed, preserve proportions. All ears/hair/horns fully inside canvas. No body, shoulders, collar, armor, shirt, neck frill, background scene, labels, guides, borders, extra head, new adornments or grayscale conversion. Preserve the approved colors. Pixel artwork suitable for nearest-neighbor reduction to 88x40.
Keep the same green male Orc, short swept black hair, pointed ears and two tusks. The large chin is presently too low and runs into the armor. Raise the complete jaw/chin enough to leave 6 logical pixels of green neck beneath it. Do not shave off the chin or crop the bottom of the jaw. Replace the rounded neck stump with the straight flat-ended modular neck specified above.
